name: First to Bachalpsee
blurb: Walk beneath the Eiger and Wetterhorn to a mirror-calm alpine lake reflecting the Bernese giants.

name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo Loop
blurb: Circle three colossal limestone towers glowing in the Dolomite sun.

name: Preikestolen Pulpit Rock
blurb: Hike up to a flat cliff ledge hanging 600 m above the Lysefjord.

name: Skyline Trail, Paradise
blurb: Wildflower meadows and glaciers beneath the 4,392 m volcano of Mount Rainier.

name: Lake Agnes Tea House
blurb: Climb above turquoise Lake Louise to a glacier-fed lake and a mountaintop tea house.

name: Kalalau Trail Cliffs
blurb: Follow sea cliffs above turquoise surf along the emerald Na Pali coast.

name: Laguna Capri, Fitz Roy
blurb: Hike from El Chaltén to a turquoise lagoon facing the jagged granite needle of Fitz Roy.

name: Lauterbrunnen to Mürren
blurb: Walk the waterfall-lined valley floor beneath the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau to Mürren.

name: Corniglia to Vernazza
blurb: Follow terraced vineyards and cliff paths above the Ligurian Sea between pastel fishing villages.

name: Eiger Trail
blurb: Trace the base of the 1,800 m Eiger North Face, past glaciers and alpine meadows.
